# Standalone smoke coverage for `ibmw bag info`.  The fixtures are copied into
# the build tree and are not generated by, or linked to, record_smoke_test.
if(NOT IBMW_BUILD_RECORD_PLAYBACK_EXTENSION)
  message(STATUS "Skip info_smoke_test: record/playback extension is disabled")
  return()
endif()

if(NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME MATCHES "Linux")
  message(STATUS "Skip info_smoke_test: Linux is required")
  return()
endif()

add_custom_target(
  ibmw_samples_cpp_info_smoke_test_build_all ALL
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory
          ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/bags
          ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/info_smoke_bags
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
          ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/validate_info_smoke.sh
          ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/validate_info_smoke.sh
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E touch
          ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/info_smoke_required
  COMMAND chmod +x ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/validate_info_smoke.sh
  DEPENDS ibmw::core::main
          ibmw_extensions_record_playback_ext)
